metadata.explanation: Task requires removing execute permissions from all files. From setup.sh, file1.txt has 755 and file3.txt has 777. Evaluator verifies no file has any execute bit set using find command.
metadata.verification: eval.sh uses 'find . -type f -executable' to detect any files with execute permissions. It verifies no executable files exist and specifically checks file1.txt and file3.txt lost their execute bits. Setup creates 3 files: file1.txt (755), file2.txt (644), file3.txt (777).
metadata.eval_script_note: The eval.sh script is created in tmp_funcs directory and needs to be uploaded to the HuggingFace cache location specified in postconfig.

eval.sh script has robust logic: uses 'find . -type f -executable' to detect ANY files with execute permissions in directory tree (recursive)
Verification is comprehensive: script checks both general condition (no executable files) and specific files (file1.txt and file3.txt that started with execute permissions)
Metric function check_include_exclude correctly validates that output includes 'All files have no execute permissions.' string when successful
